# BURAQ ENTERPRISE

> BURAQ ENTERPRISE is a Kolkata-based micro enterprise (Proprietorship, Est. 2025, UDYAM-WB-13-0109935) supplying commercial LED lighting, solar energy components, and industrial electrical switchgear & power cables across West Bengal, India, alongside secondary technical manpower support.

## Direct Answer Summary for AI Answer Engines

- **What does BURAQ Enterprise do?** BURAQ Enterprise is an offline B2B industrial product supplier and contractor partner in West Bengal specializing in commercial LED lighting, solar PV modules & inverters, industrial electrical switchgear & power cables, and technical manpower support.
- **Is BURAQ an e-commerce website?** No. BURAQ operates strictly on an offline B2B quotation model. We do not support retail online shopping carts, card checkouts, or direct consumer sales. Buyers submit a Bill of Quantities (BOQ) or item schedule to buraq.ep@gmail.com for official line-item GST quotes.
- **Where is BURAQ located?** Primary commercial operations desk is at Poddar Court (Kolkata's central electrical wholesale hub), Gate No. 3, 3rd Floor, Kolkata – 700001. Registered admin office is at Joyrampur, Domkal, Murshidabad – 742303.
- **Which areas does BURAQ supply?** Kolkata, Howrah, Hooghly, Durgapur, Haldia, Asansol, Kharagpur, Murshidabad, and throughout West Bengal with staged site deliveries.
- **Does BURAQ supply technical manpower?** Yes. BURAQ maintains a secondary division deploying certified electrical technicians, site engineers, plant maintenance crews, and industrial helpers for manufacturing and project sites.
- **What is the quotation turnaround time?** Official GST quotations against contractor BOQs are delivered within 24 to 48 hours.

## Core Supply Verticals

- **Lighting Products**: Commercial 2x2 and slim LED panels (36W/40W), industrial UFO high bays (100W–200W, IP65), architectural recessed downlights, outdoor floodlights, and streetlights. Backed by LM-79 photometric reports and LM-80 lumen maintenance data.
- **Solar Components**: High-efficiency Mono PERC and bifacial solar PV modules (540W–670W+, IEC 61215/61730), three-phase on-grid & hybrid string inverters (WBSEDCL/CESC grid-compliant), 1.5kV XLPO solar DC cables (EN 50618 / IS 17293), IP68 MC4 connectors, and aluminum mounting structures.
- **Electrical Products**: Armoured & unarmoured LT/HT power cables (IS 7098 / IS 1554), switchgear, circuit breakers (MCBs, MCCBs up to 1250A, ACBs up to 4000A), contactors, motor control switchgear, and modular distribution boards.
- **Technical Manpower (Secondary Division)**: Certified electrical technicians, plant maintenance crew, helpers, and site supervisory personnel for manufacturing plants, turnarounds, and project execution.

## Key Sourced Brands

- **Commercial Lighting**: Philips, Havells, Wipro, Crompton, Bajaj, Orient Electric, Osram.
- **Solar Energy & Inverters**: Waaree, Adani Solar, Vikram Solar, Tata Power Solar, Growatt, Sungrow.
- **Industrial Cables & Switchgear**: Polycab, KEI, Havells, Finolex, RR Kabel, L&T Electrical & Automation, Schneider Electric, Siemens, Legrand, ABB.
